title: Travel & Hotel
description: Learn to communicate during travel and at hotels

explain.ta: பயணம் மற்றும் ஹோட்டலில் ஆங்கிலத்தில் பேசுவது முக்கியம். விமான நிலையம், ரயில் நிலையம், ஹோட்டல் செக்-இன் போன்ற சூழ்நிலைகளுக்கு தயாராக இருங்கள். முக்கிய சொற்றொடர்கள்: 'I have a reservation', 'What time is check-in?', 'Where is the boarding gate?', 'Can I have a wake-up call?'. தெளிவாக பேசுவது பயணத்தை எளிதாக்கும்.
explain.en: Speaking English during travel and at hotels is important. Be prepared for situations at airports, train stations, and hotel check-ins. Key phrases: 'I have a reservation', 'What time is check-in?', 'Where is the boarding gate?', 'Can I have a wake-up call?'. Speaking clearly makes travel easier and more enjoyable.

examples: What time does the flight depart?
Can I see the room first?
Can I have a wake-up call?
Can I have a late check-out?
Where can I leave my luggage?

examples.en: Good morning. I have a reservation under the name Kumar.
examples.ta: காலை வணக்கம். குமார் என்ற பெயரில் முன்பதிவு உள்ளது.

examples.en: What time is check-in? And what time is check-out?
examples.ta: செக்-இன் நேரம் என்ன? செக்-அவுட் நேரம் என்ன?

examples.en: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
Can I have a wake-up call at 6 AM tomorrow?
examples.ta: நாளை காலை 6 மணிக்கு எழுப்பும் அழைப்பு தர முடியுமா?

examples.en: Where is the boarding gate for flight AI-505?
Is the train to Mumbai on time?
I'd like to check out. Can you prepare my bill?
examples.ta: நான் செக்-அவுட் செய்ய விரும்புகிறேன். என் பில் தயார் செய்ய முடியுமா?

examples.en: Can you call a taxi to the airport for me?
examples.ta: எனக்கு விமான நிலையத்திற்கு டாக்சி அழைக்க முடியுமா?

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Good afternoon. I have a reservation under the name Priya.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Welcome! Let me check. Yes, a double room for two nights.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: That's correct. Is breakfast included?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Yes, breakfast is served from 7 to 10 AM in the restaurant.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Great. Is there Wi-Fi in the room?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Yes, free Wi-Fi. The password is on the card in your room.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Thank you. What time is check-out?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Check-out is at 11 AM. Here's your key. Room 305.

lines.speaker: Traveler
lines.text: Excuse me, where is the check-in counter for Air India?

lines.speaker: Airport Staff
lines.text: It's in Terminal 2, counters 15 to 20.

lines.speaker: Traveler
lines.text: Thank you. And where is the boarding gate for flight AI-505?

lines.speaker: Airport Staff
lines.text: After security, go to Gate 12. Boarding starts at 2:30 PM.

lines.speaker: Traveler
lines.text: Is the flight on time?

lines.speaker: Airport Staff
lines.text: Yes, it's scheduled to depart at 3:00 PM as planned.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Good morning. I'd like to check out.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Of course. Room 305? Let me prepare your bill.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Yes. Can I have a late check-out next time?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Yes, late check-out until 2 PM is available for an extra charge.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: I see. Can you call a taxi to the airport for me?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Certainly. The taxi will be here in 10 minutes. Thank you for staying with us!
